paper_title: Fully Dynamic Maximum Independent Sets of Disks in Polylogarithmic Update Time
statement: why our algorithm does not guarantee deterministic worst-case update time, and it does not extend to balls in Rd for d ≥ 3, or to arbitrary fat objects in R2 . It remains open whether there is a dynamic nearest/farthest neighbor data structure in constant dimensions d ≥ 2 with worst-case polylogarithmic update and query time: Any such result would immediately carry over to a fully dynamic algorithm for an approximate MIS for balls in higher dimensions.
